subject: Demo request: OpenLib GitHub integration
messages:
From: Juan Perez <juan.perez@openlib.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request: OpenLib GitHub integration

Hi Camila,

I signed up for Redwood yesterday while evaluating options for embedding model-based code search into OpenLib's GitHub apps. I played with the self-serve flow and it looks promising — thanks for the docs.

We're especially interested in how Redwood integrates with GitHub: repo-level access scopes, webhooks, and whether we can host inference close to our users (data residency). Also curious about auth (SSO, tokens) and pricing at scale.

Could we set up a 30-minute demo/demo deep-dive next week? I'll include our platform engineer.

Thanks,
Juan
Juan Perez
Head of Integrations, OpenLib
juan.perez@openlib.com

Hi Juan — great to meet you and welcome!

I'd love to run a focused 30-min demo that covers: GitHub integration flows, auth patterns (SSO & token exchange), deployment options (hosted vs private), and a quick cost/latency overview for repo-scale usage. Can you share who will join from your side (roles) and what timezone you're in?

I have the following windows next week (PDT):
- Tue 2026-08-25 10:00-10:30
- Wed 2026-08-26 14:00-14:30
- Thu 2026-08-27 09:00-09:30

If none of those work, tell me a few alternatives and I can send a calendar invite.
